text:
It was left behind in your older checkout—**fixed and live now**.

- **Why:** Your ntfy topic URL was saved in `/home/anon/board/.kit/board_data/notify_url` (from Nov 24). Because `notify_url` is stored per-checkout instead of machine-wide like `board_token` (`~/.config/board-kit/`), running the board server from `/home/anon/board-streamline` did not see it.
- **Done:** Copied it into `/home/anon/board-streamline/.kit/board_data/notify_url` (permissions `0600`, git-ignored) and loaded it live into the running server via `POST /_api/notify` (`url_set: true`, `notify_detail: false`, no restart needed).
- **Note:** Under `full_auto`, `notify.py` only pushes when a post enters **To do** or **Waiting on you** (not on routine thread replies). You can hit **Test** in the Share panel if you want to verify delivery on your phone.
